title: Graph Your Own Prompt
abstract: arXiv:2509.23373v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose Graph Consistency Regularization (GCR), a novel framework that injects relational graph structures, derived from model predictions, into the learning process to promote class-aware, semantically meaningful feature representations. Functioning as a form of self-prompting, GCR enables the model to refine its internal structure using its own outputs. While deep networks learn rich representations, these often capture noisy inter-class similarities that contradict the model's predicted semantics. GCR addresses this issue by introducing parameter-free Graph Consistency Layers (GCLs) at arbitrary depths. Each GCL builds a batch-level feature similarity graph and aligns it with a global, class-aware masked prediction graph, derived by modulating softmax prediction similarities with intra-class indicators. This alignment enforces that feature-level relationships reflect class-consistent prediction behavior, acting as a seman

translated_abstract: 我们提出了图一致性正则化（Graph Consistency Regularization, GCR），这是一种新颖的框架，它将从模型预测中导出的关系图结构注入学习过程，以促进具有类感知能力且语义上有意义的特征表示。作为一种自我提示（self-prompting）的形式，GCR 使模型能够利用自身输出对其内部结构进行优化。尽管深度网络能够学习到丰富的表示，但这些表示往往捕捉到与模型预测语义相矛盾的、含噪的类间相似性。GCR 通过在任意深度引入无参数的图一致性层（Graph Consistency Layers, GCLs）来解决这一问题。每个 GCL 构建一个批级别的特征相似性图，并将其与全局的、类感知的掩码预测图对齐——该预测图通过用类内指标调制 softmax 预测相似性而得到。这种对齐强制特征层面的关系反映类一致的预测行为，从而充当一种语义层面的约束。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出图一致性正则化（GCR），通过在任意深度插入无参数的图一致性层，将特征相似性图与由模型自身预测导出的类感知掩码预测图对齐，实现自我提示式训练，使特征表示更具类一致性和语义意义。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Graph Consistency Regularization (GCR), which inserts parameter-free Graph Consistency Layers at arbitrary depths to align batch-level feature similarity graphs with class-aware masked prediction graphs derived from the model's own predictions, enabling self-prompting that yields class-consistent and semantically meaningful feature representations.
